r8-two-problem-framing.title: Two-problem framing soundness
r8-two-problem-framing.imperative: Is the bandwidth/Bahrain argument and 2D-coupling/Monaco argument each corroborated by more than one spike? Is the framing sound, not post-hoc? Record pass/fail.
r8-two-problem-framing.finding: Bandwidth argument (Bahrain) corroborated by TWO independent spikes: M3 jerk-sweep shows zero knee movement (gap 12.62-12.64 across sig_a_brake=5..80) AND M4 Q-inflation sweep shows same saturation (+12.4..+12.6). M3 directly measures the speed finite-difference (-21.2 m/s^2 at 4Hz vs raw -52.13) confirming sub-grid bandwidth. 2D-coupling argument (Monaco) corroborated by THREE spikes: M3 decoupled 1D removes ringing structurally (13.14->2.97), M4 Q-inflation WORSENS Monaco (13.38->13.99-14.18, consistent with 2D coupling), M1 confirms braking-zone anchor doesn't fix coast-zone ringing (root cause is not braking). Framing is convergent from independent negative results, not post-hoc.

r9-weak-dismissals.title: Weak mechanism dismissals fair
r9-weak-dismissals.imperative: Are M1/M4/M8 dismissed fairly? Did they fail for stated reasons? M8 knee numbers: confirm they are degenerate-fit artifacts (curve_fit covariance failure), not real improvements. Record pass/fail.
r9-weak-dismissals.finding: M1 dismissal fair: A+Bv^2 model is provably shallower than raw-52 (Bahrain knee WORSENED to -36.86..-37.69 vs baseline -39.5). No sigma rescues it -- the model average IS the problem, not a prototype defect. M4 dismissal fair: Bahrain knee plateau +12.42..+12.63 across 6 configs confirms RTS backward-pass saturation; physically explained. Monaco worsens (confirmed). M8 dismissal fair: curve_fit covariance failure documented explicitly; depth=-144.82 m/s^2 artifact on 2-point fit with RMS=0.50 confirms underdetermination. Knee -73..-80 are all-circuits artifacts. min() clip ringing gain is real but incidental. All three fail for the exact stated reasons; no prototype fix would rescue the fundamental constraints.

Neither single mechanism passes BOTH #507 acceptance circuits -- the COMBINATION is the bet, and G3 must prove M7+M3 actually composes (the synthesis risk).' The synthesis is explicitly flagged as a hypothesis G3 must validate, not an assertion. No overselling.
